title: "Exploration NDVI MODIS et relation avec la richesse"
output: html_notebook

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(sf)
})
```

## Charger les données

Ce notebook nécessite que le script `scripts/telecharger_modis.R` ait déjà été exécuté.

```{r}
ndvi <- read.csv("data/processed/ndvi_dept.csv")
direct <- read.csv("data/processed/direct_estimates_dept.csv")
admin2 <- sf::st_read("data/raw/ner_admin2.shp", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(dept_id = adm2_pcode)
```

```{r}
cat("Départements avec NDVI :", nrow(ndvi), "\n")
cat("Départements avec estimateurs directs :", nrow(direct), "\n")

# Fusion
sae <- direct %>%
  left_join(ndvi, by = "dept_id") %>%
  left_join(admin2 %>% select(dept_id, adm1_name, geometry), by = "dept_id")

cat("Départements après fusion :", nrow(sae), "\n")
```

---

## Distribution du NDVI MODIS

```{r ndvi-hist}
ggplot(ndvi, aes(x = ndvi_mean)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#2ca02c", alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
  labs(
    title    = "Distribution du NDVI MODIS moyen (2011-2012)",
    subtitle = "Moyenne sur 24 mois mensuels (MOD13A3)",
    x = "NDVI moyen", y = "Nombre de départements"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
summary(ndvi$ndvi_mean)
```

---

## Carte du NDVI par département

```{r ndvi-map, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
admin2_ndvi <- admin2 %>%
  left_join(ndvi, by = "dept_id")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = admin2_ndvi, aes(fill = ndvi_mean), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#ffffcc", high = "#006837", name = "NDVI") +
  labs(
    title    = "NDVI MODIS moyen par département (2011-2012)",
    subtitle = "Données MOD13A3, 1 km de résolution",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## Relation NDVI vs Richesse

```{r ndvi-vs-wealth}
sae_plot <- sae %>% filter(!is.na(ndvi_mean), !is.na(direct_mean))

ggplot(sae_plot, aes(x = ndvi_mean, y = direct_mean)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_clusters), alpha = 0.6, color = "#1f77b4") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#d62728", fill = "#d62728", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title    = "NDVI vs Richesse moyenne par département",
    subtitle = "1 point = 1 département, taille = nombre de clusters",
    x = "NDVI moyen (MODIS)", y = "Richesse moyenne (DHS)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
cor_val <- cor(sae_plot$ndvi_mean, sae_plot$direct_mean, use = "complete.obs")
cat("Corrélation de Pearson :", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")
cat("R² linéaire :", round(cor_val^2 * 100, 1), "%\n")
```

---

## NDVI vs Urbanisation

```{r ndvi-vs-urban}
ggplot(sae_plot, aes(x = urban_pct, y = ndvi_mean)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_clusters), alpha = 0.6, color = "#2ca02c") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#d62728") +
  labs(
    title    = "NDVI vs Taux d'urbanisation",
    subtitle = "Vérification de multicolinéarité",
    x = "Taux d'urbanisation (%)", y = "NDVI moyen"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
cor_uv <- cor(sae_plot$ndvi_mean, sae_plot$urban_pct, use = "complete.obs")
cat("Corrélation NDVI ~ urban_pct :", round(cor_uv, 3), "\n")
```

---

## Comparaison : départements avec/sans NDVI

```{r}
cat("Nombre de départements avec NDVI :", sum(!is.na(ndvi$ndvi_mean)), "\n")
cat("Nombre de départements sans NDVI :", sum(is.na(ndvi$ndvi_mean)), "\n")

if (any(is.na(ndvi$ndvi_mean))) {
  cat("\nDépartements sans NDVI :\n")
  print(ndvi %>% filter(is.na(ndvi_mean)) %>% select(dept_id, dept_name))
}
```
